plan.summary: BRO-5254 5-row test: strip the Variety 'Related Stories' / 'Popular on Variety' promo modules from 5 stored Variety review texts (evenly spread over the 403 strippable rows). Dry run on 2026-10-13 (run-script, all rows) showed 821 removed lines, every one a Variety headline or 'VIP+'. verify-live on the same 5 rows: 3 matched the live article with no removed line in the article body; 2 pages redirect (url_mismatch), their removed lines are headlines of other Variety stories. Each stripped row gets needsRescore with reason 'variety-promo-bleed (BRO-5254)' and keeps its pre-strip score for the A/B.
steps: Run strip-variety-promo-bleed.js --apply --limit=5 (same evenly spaced 5 rows as the verify-live check).
Re-run the dry run and --ab to confirm the 5 rows are clean and queued for rescore.
